description: WhatsApp's channel directory: channels whose name matches `query`, in the countries asked for, or without a query the directory's recommended, trending, popular or new channels. Each channel comes with its follower count, verification, description and invite code (use it with Get Channel and Get Channel Posts). Channels the lookup account follows are not listed. Group: Channels. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, comma-separated (up to 10). Default `US`.

limit.description: How many channels to return, 1–50. Default 20.

query.description: Text to look for in channel names, up to 100 characters. Without it, `view` decides what is listed.

view.description: Which directory list to browse when there is no query.

name: get_v1_channels_search
title: Search Channels
